Labels.io.driftscope.changelog: Added Idempotency-Key header support on POST /charge. Retries no longer double-charge. Fixed timezone handling in settlement reports.
Labels.io.driftscope.known-issues: Idempotency keys are held in memory only; a pod restart loses them.
